description: Call off a meeting you organized. Every guest gets a cancellation and the event leaves their calendar. Confirm with your operator first.

credentials_dir.description: Credential directory for this call (default: ATOMIC_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_DIR or ~/.atomicmail). Use separate paths per account; see help topic multi_account.

note.description: Optional message to the guests, e.g. the reason.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the date written in the email (default UTC).

name: cancel_invite
title: Cancel a meeting
